\begin{tablenotes}[flushleft]
\footnotesize
\item \textit{Sign:} ablation cells are $100\,(L_{\text{row}}/L_{\text{ref}} - 1)$, the percentage change in mean QLIKE against the reference, as in Table~\ref{tab:rh_ablation}.  Added to HAR (reference: the class's own HAR benchmark fit): negative, the loss falls when the group is added, i.e.\ the group adds accuracy.  Dropped from the full set (reference: the full set): positive, the loss rises when the group is dropped, i.e.\ the group adds accuracy.  $^{*}$ Diebold--Mariano test rejects equal accuracy at 5\% (two-sided; daily average QLIKE, Newey--West lag 8).
\item \textit{Notes:} Post hoc, requested by the author on 28 October; not pre-registered.  LGBM, XGB, RF: LightGBM, XGBoost, random forest.  Base: the HAR benchmark set plus the futures' realized moments (RM) and the FOMC calendar.  Attribution: mean $|\mathrm{SHAP}|$ share of the group's series in the tree's exogenous total (the eight groups, which sum to 100; the HAR components and calendar dummies, 53--58\% of the trees' total, are left out), over all 33{,}970 explained bars or the 1{,}014 bars of the 78 scheduled FOMC statement days with a release stamp (the three 2023--24 statements without one count as ordinary days); the ordinary-day shares differ from the every-bar shares by at most 2.2 points.  Ridge: share of the absolute coefficients on the window-standardized predictors, summed over the origins (Table~\ref{tab:rh_fip_shares}), a different measure.  Ablations: FOMC-patched design, the 33{,}527 scored bars of Table~\ref{tab:rh_oos}, every arm at the full set's frozen hyperparameters; \dag{} on the pre-patch design against the pre-patch full set; the forest's other removals were not run.  The six together: shares summed; dropped, HAR + RM + FOMC against the full set.  Spearman $\rho$: rank correlation over the eight groups of the model's every-bar share with its change (larger shares going with larger gains: negative under Added, positive under Dropped).  Sources: \texttt{results/\allowbreak{}tree\_\allowbreak{}shap\_\allowbreak{}w3000\_\allowbreak{}2014start\_\allowbreak{}fomcfix\_\allowbreak{}2026-10-26} (m1\_buckets, m4\_subsets, m2\_linear\_shares) and \texttt{results/\allowbreak{}ablations\_\allowbreak{}2014start\_\allowbreak{}w3000/\allowbreak{}scores\_\allowbreak{}fomcfix} (metrics, dm).
\end{tablenotes}
